mcqs.question: What key limitation of RNNs did Transformers primarily address?
mcqs.correct_answer: Difficulty modeling long-range dependencies efficiently

mcqs.question: What is the core mechanism that powers Transformers?
mcqs.correct_answer: Self-attention

mcqs.question: Why do Transformers need positional encoding?
mcqs.correct_answer: To provide token order information

mcqs.question: What does self-attention allow a token to do?
options: Ignore the rest of the sequence
Attend to other tokens in the same sequence
mcqs.correct_answer: Attend to other tokens in the same sequence

mcqs.question: What is the purpose of the query, key, and value vectors in attention?
options: To compute contextual relationships between tokens
mcqs.correct_answer: To compute contextual relationships between tokens

mcqs.question: What is multi-head attention designed to do?
options: Capture different types of relationships in parallel
mcqs.correct_answer: Capture different types of relationships in parallel

mcqs.question: What is the role of the feed-forward network inside a Transformer block?
options: To apply nonlinear transformation to each position independently
mcqs.correct_answer: To apply nonlinear transformation to each position independently

mcqs.question: Why are residual connections used in Transformers?
options: To improve gradient flow and stabilize training
mcqs.correct_answer: To improve gradient flow and stabilize training

mcqs.question: What is the purpose of layer normalization in Transformer blocks?
mcqs.correct_answer: Stabilize activations during training

mcqs.question: What is masking in Transformer decoding primarily used for?
options: To hide labels from the dataset
To prevent attending to future tokens
mcqs.correct_answer: To prevent attending to future tokens

mcqs.question: What is the main difference between an encoder and a decoder in the original Transformer architecture?
options: Decoder uses masked self-attention and cross-attention
mcqs.correct_answer: Decoder uses masked self-attention and cross-attention

mcqs.question: What is cross-attention used for in encoder-decoder models?
options: To compare model outputs with labels
To let the decoder attend to encoder outputs
mcqs.correct_answer: To let the decoder attend to encoder outputs

mcqs.question: Why are Transformers highly parallelizable during training compared to RNNs?
options: They process tokens without strict sequential recurrence
mcqs.correct_answer: They process tokens without strict sequential recurrence

mcqs.question: What is a major computational drawback of standard self-attention?
options: Its cost grows quadratically with sequence length
mcqs.correct_answer: Its cost grows quadratically with sequence length

mcqs.question: Why do token embeddings matter in a Transformer?
options: They convert discrete tokens into dense vectors
They reduce the number of layers
mcqs.correct_answer: They convert discrete tokens into dense vectors

mcqs.question: What is bidirectional context in Transformer-based NLP models?
options: Using both left and right context for token representation
mcqs.correct_answer: Using both left and right context for token representation

mcqs.question: Why are Transformer pretraining objectives important?
options: They define how the model learns general language representations
mcqs.correct_answer: They define how the model learns general language representations

mcqs.question: What is teacher forcing in sequence generation training?
options: Using model predictions as all future inputs
Using ground-truth previous tokens during training
mcqs.correct_answer: Using ground-truth previous tokens during training

mcqs.question: What is one reason Transformers are effective beyond NLP?
options: Attention can model relationships in many data modalities
They replace all convolution layers automatically
mcqs.correct_answer: Attention can model relationships in many data modalities

mcqs.question: What is the main purpose of attention scores before softmax?
options: To measure token relevance before normalization
mcqs.correct_answer: To measure token relevance before normalization
